TS language shortcoming: the post-`yield(record)` half of the Rails body (collection_association.rb:471-486) has to be a closure so the block arm can run it from `.then`, and a closure must be declared before the `try` that uses it — so `loaded?` and `after_add` read earlier in source order than the `before_add` call that precedes them at runtime.
